marketing.home-meta-title: Smart clinical records for Traditional Chinese Medicine
marketing.home-meta-description: Organize patients, intake forms, analyses and treatment plans in a platform built for TCM. Start for free and automate your consultations with AI.
marketing.hero-eyebrow: Smart clinical records for Traditional Chinese Medicine
marketing.hero-title: Care with your eyes on the patient. MedChina handles the rest.
marketing.hero-subtitle: Record the consultation with consent, get the intake form filled in, and receive analyses, protocols and a treatment plan prepared for your review — without giving up clinical control.
marketing.bento-title: More clinical presence. More continuity. Less repetitive work.
marketing.pricing-title: Choose how much of your work you want to automate.
marketing.pricing-subtitle: Start for free and switch when automation makes sense. Assistente records and organizes the consultation; Pro also prepares treatment possibilities for your review.
marketing.pricing-page-title: Plans for different levels of automation
marketing.pricing-page-subtitle: Free keeps the full manual clinical work. Assistente automates the documentation. Pro also prepares the therapeutic reasoning.
marketing.pricing-note: *Launch prices under validation. Subscription and billing happen on the web; the Pro trial (14 days or 300 minutes) starts only at your first real AI consultation, no card required.
marketing.pricing-meta-title: Plans and pricing — TCM clinical records
marketing.pricing-meta-description: Compare MedChina Free, Assistente and Pro: unlimited manual records, consultation transcription and treatment-plan preparation. Start without a card.
marketing.plan-1-description: To organize your practice and use the clinical tools manually.
marketing.plan-2-description: To run consultations without depending on note-taking.
marketing.plan-2-feature-3: Up to 3,000 minutes per month (~60 visits)
marketing.plan-3-description: To automate documentation and prepare the therapeutic reasoning.
marketing.plan-3-feature-3: Up to 6,000 minutes per month (~120 visits)
marketing.faq-1-question: Can I use MedChina for free?
marketing.faq-1-answer: Yes. The Free plan lets you register patients, record consultations and use the manual clinical tools with no limit on patients or records. Recording, transcription and automation belong to the paid plans and the Pro trial.
marketing.faq-2-question: Does the trial start when I create my account?
marketing.faq-2-answer: No. You can explore and set up MedChina for free. The Pro trial starts only when you decide to run your first real AI consultation.
marketing.faq-3-question: Do I need a card to try Pro?
marketing.faq-3-answer: No. The trial requires no card and never charges automatically.
marketing.faq-4-question: What happens when the trial ends?
marketing.faq-4-answer: Your account returns to the Free plan. Patients, records and everything you produced stay accessible; only new AI processing is unavailable until you subscribe.
marketing.cta-title: Start for free. Automate when you're ready.
marketing.cta-subtitle: Organize your patients, use MedChina's clinical tools and get to know the automation at your own pace. Your history stays yours, with or without a paid plan.
marketing.about-meta-description: MedChina exists so Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioners can care with more presence: specialized records, supervised AI and clinical control.
marketing.about-title: Technology in service of clinical listening
marketing.about-subtitle: We believe attention to the patient comes before interaction with screens.
marketing.about-story-p1: MedChina is an electronic clinical record and practice platform for Traditional Chinese Medicine. The new version connects registration, intake, analysis, protocols, treatment plan and documents in a single flow, supported by supervised AI.
marketing.about-story-p2: The practitioner stays at the center: the AI records, organizes, compares and prepares — reviewing, validating and signing remain human decisions. That division of roles shapes every product detail.
marketing.about-value-1-description: Fewer screens and less typing during the visit, giving attention back to the patient.
marketing.about-value-2-description: Facts, observations and inferences visually distinct, with a recoverable origin.
marketing.about-value-3-description: A genuinely usable free base; we charge for automation, not for the record.

marketing.terms-1-body: By creating an account you agree to these terms. If you use the service on behalf of a company, you confirm you are authorized to accept them for that company. This is placeholder text — replace it with terms reviewed by your legal counsel before launch.
marketing.terms-2-body: You are responsible for the activity in your organization's account and for keeping credentials safe. Usage must comply with applicable law; abuse, unauthorized access attempts and resale without agreement are prohibited.
marketing.terms-3-body: Paid plans renew automatically for the chosen period and can be cancelled at any time from the billing page, keeping access until the end of the paid period. Price changes are announced in advance and never apply retroactively.
marketing.terms-4-body: The service is provided as described, with reasonable commercial efforts to keep it available. Either party may terminate the agreement; on termination you can export your data, and records required by law remain retained as described in the privacy policy.
marketing.privacy-1-body: Account data (name, email), organization data your team enters, and technical logs needed to operate the service. This is placeholder text — replace it with a policy reviewed by your legal counsel (LGPD/GDPR as applicable) before launch.
marketing.privacy-2-body: To provide the service, process payments through our providers, send transactional email and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.
marketing.privacy-3-body: Data is stored with per-organization isolation enforced at the database level, encrypted in transit, with access restricted by role. Audit events are retained append-only.
marketing.privacy-4-body: You can request access, correction, export or deletion of your personal data. Consent records are versioned, and you can review what was accepted and when from your account.
marketing.hero-note: No card required. Unlimited patients and manual records.
marketing.trust-title: Free for manual work. Paid only for automation.
marketing.trust-1-body: Use the manual clinical tools with no limit on patients or records.
marketing.trust-2-body: Start the Pro trial only when you are ready to test a real AI consultation.
marketing.trust-3-body: Filled fields, hypotheses and suggestions always wait for your validation.
marketing.trust-4-title: Work on the web, record on your phone
marketing.trust-4-body: The mobile app captures the visit; the web platform holds the full experience.
marketing.flow-title: From conversation to clinical record, in one flow.
marketing.flow-subtitle: MedChina connects what happens during the consultation to what you need to review and record after it.
marketing.flow-1-body: Select the patient, confirm consent and start the consultation from the mobile app.
marketing.flow-2-body: The conversation is transcribed, speakers are identified and the information lands in the right intake fields.
marketing.flow-3-body: Changes, gaps, ambiguities and possible contradictions surface in a review focused on exceptions.
marketing.flow-4-body: Review the analysis, adjust recommendations and protocols, confirm the treatment plan and close the record.
marketing.flow-cta-note: The demo uses fictitious data and does not start your trial.
marketing.problem-title: Your attention shouldn't be split between the patient and the computer.
marketing.problem-subtitle: A TCM consultation demands listening, observation and individual reading. MedChina cuts the operational effort so you can be more present and review only what needs your decision.
marketing.problem-before-3: Filling the intake form after the visit
marketing.problem-before-5: Rebuilding the treatment plan from scratch
marketing.problem-after-5: Closing the record in a single flow
marketing.benefit-1-title: Be in the consultation, not in the form
marketing.benefit-1-body: Use mobile capture and voice commands to type less during the visit.
marketing.benefit-2-title: The conversation finds the right field
marketing.benefit-2-body: Symptoms, habits, emotions, medications, exams and progress are prepared inside MedChina's clinical structure.
marketing.benefit-3-title: See what changed since the last visit
marketing.benefit-3-body: Compare reports, symptoms, techniques and responses over the course of care.
marketing.benefit-4-body: On Pro, the system shows possible patterns, supporting signs, contradictions, missing data and references for your analysis.
marketing.benefit-5-title: From pattern to plan, without starting over
marketing.benefit-5-body: Recommendations, combinations, protocols, guidance and drafts are organized for review.
marketing.benefit-6-body: Nothing is finalized automatically. You edit, reject, validate and sign.
marketing.mobile-title: Your phone captures the visit. The platform organizes the care.
marketing.mobile-body: The mobile app makes consented recording and voice observations easy. It complements the web platform, where you review the intake form, the analysis and the treatment plan.
marketing.mobile-bullet-1: Today's consultations and safe patient selection
marketing.mobile-bullet-3: Start, pause, resume and finish recordings
marketing.mobile-bullet-4: Tongue, pulse and palpation dictated by voice
marketing.mobile-highlight-title: An unstable connection doesn't mean a lost consultation.
marketing.mobile-highlight-body: When needed, the recording stays safely on the device and is sent once the connection returns. The app shows whether the audio is on the phone, being sent, or confirmed by the server.
marketing.mobile-note: The app is a companion for Assistente and Pro subscribers. Sign-up, plans and payments are managed on the web platform.
marketing.rows-title: Filled from the conversation. Decided by you.
marketing.rows-subtitle: Every piece of information keeps its source, every hypothesis asks for validation — and what wasn't said stays blank.
marketing.row-anamnese-title: The intake form is filled without turning absence into an answer.
marketing.row-anamnese-body: MedChina organizes what was reported in the consultation, keeps the origin of each item and leaves blank whatever wasn't mentioned. Ambiguous, contradictory or sensitive fields are flagged for review.
marketing.row-anamnese-bullet-1: Clear evidence: backed by an identifiable excerpt of the conversation
marketing.row-anamnese-bullet-2: Needs attention: ambiguity, contradiction or clinically sensitive data
marketing.row-anamnese-bullet-3: Not reported: the topic didn't come up and stays blank
marketing.row-pro-title: AI prepares possibilities. You define the treatment.
marketing.row-pro-body: From the intake and the history, Pro organizes disharmony-pattern hypotheses, shows supporting and contradicting signs and prepares recommendations for your review. Nothing replaces physical examination, tongue, pulse or contraindication checks.
marketing.row-pro-bullet-1: Hypotheses with supporting signs, contradictions and missing data
marketing.row-pro-bullet-2: Points, combinations and protocols in context
marketing.row-pro-bullet-3: Treatment plan and drafts prepared for validation
marketing.row-trace-title: You can always see where the information came from.
marketing.row-trace-body: Every field the AI fills keeps a link to the matching excerpt of the consultation. Listen to the context, fix interpretations and record your decision without treating a suggestion as clinical fact.
marketing.row-trace-bullet-1: Patient report — fills the field and keeps the source excerpt
marketing.row-trace-bullet-2: Practitioner observation — dictated by voice, never inferred from the patient's speech
marketing.row-trace-bullet-3: AI inference — shown separately, never treated as fact
marketing.row-trace-bullet-4: Professional decision — recorded as the final course, with author and date
marketing.trace-source-quote: “I've been waking up about three times every night.”
marketing.mtc-title: A clinical record built for the logic of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
marketing.mtc-subtitle: Instead of adapting your consultation to a generic record, MedChina organizes the assessment around the elements of TCM practice.
marketing.mtc-support: Use MedChina's templates, customize your intake form and keep your own way of caring.
marketing.migration-title: Did you use a previous version of MedChina?
marketing.migration-body: The new platform runs on a different foundation. Create a new account and, if you need your data, request a migration assessment from support.
marketing.faq-5-question: Does the AI make clinical decisions for me?
marketing.faq-5-answer: No. The AI organizes information, points out gaps and, on Pro, prepares hypotheses and treatment possibilities. Review, validation and the final decision stay with the practitioner.
marketing.faq-6-question: Does the AI invent answers for fields that weren't mentioned?
marketing.faq-6-answer: What wasn't reported stays blank — absence never becomes a negative answer. Ambiguous or contradictory fields are flagged, and every extracted item can be traced to its excerpt.
marketing.faq-7-question: Do I have to record every consultation?
marketing.faq-7-answer: No. Recording is optional and depends on consent. The manual tools remain available whenever you can't or don't want to record.
marketing.faq-8-question: Does the mobile app replace the web version?
marketing.faq-8-answer: No. The app is a companion focused on audio capture, voice commands and processing status. Full review, plans and settings live on the web.
marketing.faq-9-question: Will my data train public models?
marketing.faq-9-answer: MedChina's policy forbids using clinical information to train public models. Details about providers, retention and processing live in the privacy documentation.
marketing.faq-10-answer: Yes, from the web platform. Cancelling stops future charges under the contracted policy, without erasing the records you created.
marketing.security-title: Clinical data demands more than convenience. It demands control.
marketing.security-subtitle: MedChina is designed to handle health information with security, traceability and minimization — privacy, consent and audit controls built into the clinical flow.
marketing.security-1-body: Recording, transcription, AI use and images can each have specific, versioned authorizations.
marketing.security-2-body: You set the retention policy; the local copy is removed only after the upload is safely confirmed.
marketing.security-3-body: Two-factor authentication, session management, encryption and access logs protect the workspace.
marketing.security-4-body: Finalizations, edits and addenda stay traceable, with author, date and version.
marketing.security-5-body: Clinical data never trains public models, and providers follow the platform's rules.
marketing.hiw-meta-title: How MedChina's AI clinical record works
marketing.hiw-meta-description: See how a consented recording becomes a filled intake form, with highlighted gaps and a treatment plan prepared for your review. Demo with fictitious data.
marketing.hiw-title: From consented recording to final review, step by step.
marketing.hiw-subtitle: A real consultation travels this path: safe capture, transcription with speaker identification, structured intake and a review focused on exceptions.
marketing.hiw-rows-title: Clear states at every step — nothing happens silently.
marketing.hiw-rows-subtitle: From audio on the device to the closed record, you always know where the consultation stands.
marketing.hiw-row-1-title: A recording only counts as sent when the server confirms it.
marketing.hiw-row-1-body: Audio stays encrypted on the device, uploads resume after connection drops, and processing shows progress — no promise of instant results.
marketing.hiw-row-1-bullet-3: Notification when the review is ready
marketing.hiw-row-2-title: Each field tells you why it needs (or doesn't need) your attention.
marketing.hiw-row-2-body: Per-field states focus the review on exceptions: approve whole sections with clear evidence and look closely only at what was flagged.
marketing.features-meta-title: Features — software for acupuncturists and TCM
marketing.features-meta-description: Schedule, patients, integrative intake, timeline, QR-verified documents and clinical library — free. AI transcription and treatment plans on paid tiers.
marketing.features-page-title: Everything your TCM practice needs, in one place.
marketing.features-page-subtitle: The clinical base is free and unlimited. Automation joins when you want, without changing how you care.
marketing.feat-web-title: The complete clinical base, at no cost.
marketing.feat-web-subtitle: Unlimited manual tools for patients and records — the Free plan is for real work.
marketing.feat-web-1-body: Registration, clinical alerts, versioned consents and a timeline of consultations and treatments.
marketing.feat-web-2-body: Create, reschedule and link consultations to patients, opening Consultation Mode in one tap.
marketing.feat-web-3-body: Expandable, customizable blocks: complaint, routine, emotions and the full TCM assessment.
marketing.feat-web-4-body: Symptoms, techniques, responses and documents across the course of care, filtered by period and problem.
marketing.feat-web-5-body: Session plans, guidance and documents with identification, version and QR validation.
marketing.feat-web-6-body: Traditional sources, internal protocols and evidence classified separately, referenced next to each suggestion.
marketing.sec-meta-description: Versioned consent, encryption, 2FA, audit trails and audio retention under your control. See how MedChina treats health data by design.
marketing.sec-rows-title: How control shows up in daily work
marketing.sec-row-1-title: Each purpose has its own authorization, with version and date.
marketing.sec-row-1-body: Recording, AI transcription and clinical images are separate, versioned authorizations. Refusing to record never blocks manual care.
marketing.sec-row-1-bullet-1: Version, date and form of acceptance recorded
marketing.sec-row-1-bullet-3: Per-consultation confirmation or a defined policy
marketing.sec-row-2-title: A closed record never changes silently.
marketing.sec-row-2-body: Corrections become addenda with author, date and reason, preserving the original entry. Every extracted item keeps its link to the source.
marketing.sec-caution: Built with privacy and data-protection requirements from the start. This page is not legal advice; provider, retention and processing details live in the privacy documentation.
marketing.mig-meta-description: Used the old MedChina? The new platform requires a new account. See how to request a data migration assessment from support.
marketing.mig-title: Coming from the previous version? Start the right way.
marketing.mig-subtitle: The new platform runs on a different foundation. Create a new account to begin; data migration is assessed case by case by support.
marketing.mig-1-body: Tell us which version you used and what you want to bring: patients, records, documents.
marketing.mig-2-body: We analyze format, volume and integrity of the available data before any commitment.
marketing.mig-3-body: When feasible, the import runs in a controlled way, with a final check.
marketing.mig-note-body: Migration is not automatic and depends on the analysis of your data's format, volume and integrity. Timelines and conditions are set case by case — meanwhile, your new account already works normally.
marketing.mig-cta-subtitle: Support assesses your case and recommends the best path.
marketing.footer-disclaimer: MedChina does not replace professional assessment, physical examination, tongue observation, pulse palpation, contraindication analysis or referral when necessary.
marketing.cookies-1-body: Cookies are small files stored in your browser. MedChina uses essential cookies for session, security and preferences such as language and theme.
marketing.cookies-2-body: Essential cookies keep you signed in and protect the platform. Preference cookies remember your interface choices. We do not use cookies to sell personal data.
marketing.cookies-3-body: You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings; essential features may stop working. If in doubt, contact support.

product.checklistSubtitle: Three steps to your first finalized record.
product.onboardingHint: A couple of quick steps and you'll see your first result.
product.onboardingScaffold: This wizard is a scaffold. Replace these steps with the setup and personalization your product needs — and end on a screen that shows what the answers unlocked.
product.no-workspace: We couldn't find your workspace. Reload the page and try again.
product.onboarding-step-profile-description: The name and details that appear on documents.
product.onboarding-step-consultation-description: Record the intake and close the chart.
product.start-title: How would you like to start?
product.start-subtitle: Pick a starting point. You can change your mind anytime — nothing here starts the Pro trial.
product.start-manual-body: Register your first patient and record a manual consultation, your way.
product.start-demo-body: Watch a recorded consultation become a filled intake form, with fictitious data.
product.start-ai-body: Set up your profile and consents before your first real AI consultation.
product.start-trial-note: The Pro trial only starts at your first real AI consultation. No card required.
product.home-empty-title: Start by registering your first patient
product.home-empty-body: MedChina organizes patients, consultations and records. Register someone to open your first consultation.
product.home-drafts-subtitle: Drafts still waiting for your review and sign-off.
product.home-drafts-empty-body: When you start a consultation, it stays here until you finalize it.
product.patients-empty-body: Register the first person you care for. Only the name is required — everything else comes when it matters.
product.patient-alerts-hint: Shown before every consultation. Press Enter to add.
product.patient-privacy-body: Only the name is required. Tax id, address and emergency contact are not asked here: sensitive data is collected when there's a clear purpose.
product.patient-timeline-empty-body: Start the first consultation to record this patient's intake.
product.consultation-anamnesis-subtitle: Record what was reported or observed. Whatever stays blank remains “not reported”.
product.consultation-finalize-body: Once finalized, the record cannot be rewritten. Corrections become addenda, with author and date.
product.consultation-finalized-notice: Record finalized. To correct something, add an addendum — the original entry is preserved.
product.consultation-state-body: {count} fields filled so far. Answers save automatically.
product.consultation-absence-note: A blank field means “not reported” — never a negative answer.
product.consultation-addendum-body: An addendum complements the finalized record without overwriting anything. It is stored with author and date.
product.consent-audio-hint: Allows recording consultation audio. Recording is optional and refusing it never blocks manual care.
product.consent-ai-hint: Allows transcribing and organizing the consultation with AI support, always under your review.
product.consent-images-hint: Allows recording clinical images (tongue, treated area) to follow the patient's progress.
product.consent-note-body: Each purpose is granted separately and can be revoked at any time. The authorization history is kept for audit; nothing is deleted.
product.consent-term-missing: Consent term not found. Reload the page.
product.recorder-no-consent: This patient hasn't authorized audio recording yet. The manual consultation stays available.
product.recorder-uploaded: Audio sent and confirmed by the server.
product.recorder-mic-denied: Could not access the microphone. Check the browser permission.
product.recorder-note: Audio only counts as sent after the server confirms it. AI transcription depends on your plan.
product.consultation-review-attention: AI-prepared draft. {count} field(s) flagged “needs attention” for your review.
product.consultation-review-ready: AI-prepared draft. Review, adjust and finalize when you agree.
product.consultation-gaps-subtitle: Relevant topics that didn't come up in the consultation. Suggestions — never answers.
product.recordings-note: Processing transcribes the consultation and prepares a draft anamnesis for your review. Requires AI consent and depends on your plan.
